reactors.system_instruction: You are a local computer vision flower analyzer. You analyze patio flower captures and count the flowers by color. You MUST return a single raw JSON object with EXACTLY these 5 keys: yellow_flowers, orange_light_flowers, orange_dark_flowers, total_flowers, analysis_summary. Do not output any markdown formatting, preambles, explanations, extra keys, or backticks. Output only raw JSON. Rules: 1. Count yellow_flowers, orange_light_flowers, orange_dark_flowers. 2. total_flowers MUST be an integer representing the sum of all counts. 3. analysis_summary MUST be a string describing the visual status of the backyard plants.
reactors.semantic_prompt_template:
Analyze the flower capture for patio '{{index .trigger_event "$producer"}}'.

Patio View S3 URI: {{index .trigger_event "fields" "patio_view"}}

reactors.context_query: SELECT raw_json FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'AICognitiveProfile' AND json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.reactor_id') = 'patio-flower-counter' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 5

audit_status.instructions: Evaluate the execution efficiency and latency health of the vision AI reactor based on its AICognitiveProfile telemetry history.

criteria.OPTIMAL: Execution succeeded with low hydration (<50ms) and fast vision inference (<1500ms) or nominal empty baseline
criteria.ACCEPTABLE: Execution succeeded with moderate inference latency (1500ms - 3000ms) and zero errors
criteria.DEGRADED: Elevated inference latency (>3000ms) or cold-start bottleneck observed across historical runs
criteria.ANOMALOUS: Erratic latency spikes, schema coercion warnings, or confidence drops detected in profile history
criteria.TIMEOUT: Execution timed out or failed to return a valid response within the deadline

avg_latency_ms.instructions: Estimate the average total execution latency in milliseconds (0 to 5000 ms) from the AICognitiveProfile history (or 0 if no history logs are present).
criteria: 0 ms: No historical telemetry records yet (nominal baseline)
1500 ms: Standard multimodal VLM inference latency
3000 ms: Elevated inference latency under edge compute load
5000 ms: Severe latency saturation or cold-start stall

mapping_template.efficiency_summary: string(resp.audit_status) == 'OPTIMAL' || string(resp.audit_status) == 'ACCEPTABLE' ? 'System One cognitive audit verified nominal VLM execution (' + string(resp.audit_status) + ', avg ' + string(resp.avg_latency_ms) + ' ms) with RLCD confidence ' + string(ai.round(double(resp.confidence) * 100.0, 1)) + '%.' : 'ALERT: System One cognitive audit flagged ' + string(resp.audit_status) + ' execution state (' + string(resp.avg_latency_ms) + ' ms); inspect edge VLM latency and hydration load.'

reactors.system_instruction: You are a System One cognitive performance auditor evaluating AICognitiveProfile execution telemetry for edge multimodal AI reactors.
